Job Description

Do you have a strong desire to test your skills in an inspiring company that provides some of the most innovative digital financial solutions on the market? Are you hard-working, eager to learn and a team player?

An opportunity to take part in the entire software development process

We are looking for skilled software engineering interns for Danske Bank’s Development Center in the center of Aarhus. We offer a dynamic and international software engineering environment with more than 300 IT employees who have developed well-known products such as Netbank, Mobilbank, Månedsinvestering and District the Corporates' version of Netbank.

As an intern, you will get different exciting and challenging assignments. You will join a squad and be involved in the development process end-to-end, including everything from specifying requirements and discussing solutions to developing, testing and releasing. Depending on the squad you become part of, you will have the opportunity to work on assignments ranging from front-end development to back-end development and integrations.

At Danske Bank, we work with a wide range of both front-end and back-end technologies and agile working methods, such as Scrum, test-driven development, domain driven design and more.

The different cutting edge technologies and methodologies you can encounter include among others:

C#, Java, Javascript, Typescript, HTML, CSS, F#, Terraform, Python, PowerShell
.NET, Spring Boot, Angular, React, GraphQL, Node.js
RabbitMQ, Kafka, WebSphere MQ
Containers, Docker, OpenShift, Kubernetes
MSSQL, Elasticsearch, DB2, Cassandra, Redis
Microservice architecture, Message oriented middleware, Continuous Integration/Continuous Delivery, Git, REST API’s, gRPC
Domain driven design, CQRS, Event sourcing

Curious and proactive software developer

If you are curious, and you enjoy new challenges as well as learning about new technologies and new development methods you will fit in well with us. You have to be dedicated and proactive and you should also have a positive approach to your assignments and independently provide suggestions for solutions. We are looking for a team player to take part in knowledge-sharing and sparring. What we are looking for in you as intern is the following qualifications:

Good analytical and problem-solving skills
Self-starter with great collaboration skills
Good communication skills
Proficiency in verbal and written English, as group language is English

We are open to candidates who comes from a variety of backgrounds and are interested in the overall skillset you bring to the table.

Kickstart your future now!

As an intern, you will be able to take the first steps in your future career. We have a young environment with student workers and recent graduates alongside very experienced team members.

The internship will last 20 weeks from February 2027 to August 2027 and must be part of your education plan. You will be employed on a full-time basis. This position will be based in Aarhus and requires a minimum of 37 hours work a week.

Interested?

We hire on an ongoing basis, so send your application, CV and grades as soon as possible. We look forward to hearing from you. If you have any questions regarding the position, please do not hesitate to contact us at ITstudent@danskebank.dk

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer - GRC Infrastructure
jobs.description:
In this Staff Software Engineering role, you’ll be…

Responsible for the full product development end-to-end.
A technical lighthouse, defining architecture, balancing business needs with long-term technical health, and coordinating with other engineers to move how we do engineering forward.
Collaborating across Engineering, Product, and Design to shape the solution to the problem and oversee technical implementations from end to end.
A leader and mentor without direct people management. Continuous learning and knowledge-sharing are in your DNA, as you challenge the status quo, unblock engineers across the organisation, and mentor senior team members to help them achieve greater impact.

Who is the GRC Infrastructure Team?

The GRC Infrastructure team is the core team of our Formalize product, which works on our strategic mission to build the flexible and secure engine that powers our entire Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC) platform.

Here, the team designs, builds, and maintains the foundational modules to support our customers in their GRC needs.

Essentially, we build things from an infrastructure-first principle, where we solve specific GRC problems with generic and flexible modules to allow our customers to shape our software to their specific needs.

Our tech stack:

PHP with Laravel
Angular 22
TailwindCSS
PostgreSQL
Redis for caching
Claude Code
Serverless infrastructure on AWS

Not an expert in our entire stack? No problem. At Formalize, we value curiosity and a willingness to learn. With solid fundamentals and the right mindset, we will help you grow the rest.

What you’ll bring:

Expert knowledge in at least one layer of our technical stack (we work with PHP and Angular), as well as general software architecture and system design.
Demonstrated staff experience in a Software Engineering role, designing, building, and maintaining highly scalable systems in production, end-to-end.
Experience in product development with a focus on quality and value delivery.
The ability to clearly define technical direction for systems and lead deep architectural and software design sessions.
Good engineering practices for testing, deployment, & observability paired with the ability to communicate strategic trade-offs clearly, mentor senior colleagues, and increase impact across the organisation.
The ability to raise the bar for engineering quality and performance through reference implementations and by defining ever-evolving code standards.

We offer you:

A starting salary of 79,000 DKK per month. As you grow within this role, your compensation can grow with you up to 89,000 DKK per month.
Continuous development through a clear and transparent framework, so you always know what the next step looks like through bi-annual growth talks and regular check-ins.
Thorough pre-boarding and onboarding to set you up for success.
An office-first culture in a centrally located office, along with visa support if needed.
A culture of ownership, trust, and independence with the support you need.
A strong team spirit where we celebrate wins and enjoy time together across offices.
Our annual Global Summit, where the whole company connects over strategic achievements and projects.

Our recruitment process:

Send your application and upload relevant information.
30-minute online interview with our Talent Acquisition team.
30-minute online interview with the Hiring Manager.
Completion of Personality Assessment & 1h Technical Assessment.
A collaborative no-coding session where we work through building a real feature in Formalize: clarifying requirements, data modelling, and walking through pseudo-code together.

30-minute walkthrough of our career framework and offer details.
60-minute in-person interview to meet the team.

About Formalize

Formalize is a tech company founded in 2021 with offices in Aarhus, Copenhagen, Milan, Madrid and Munich. Currently, we are a team of +200 people from 19 nationalities operating in multiple European markets and are one of the fastest growing SaaS scale-ups. We thrive on ambition, deliver impact through pragmatism, and embrace passion and honesty. We are celebrating our wins, learn from our mistakes, and grow together as a team.

Our journey began within the whistleblowing compliance sector, highlighted by the award-winning Whistleblower Software by Formalize, laying the foundation of our success story. Now, we have extended our expertise to a larger compliance universe, including data compliance, risk, and privacy.

Our Formalize product helps companies to effortlessly navigate and stay ahead in the ever-changing landscape of compliance. Our platform adapts to regulatory changes, continuously adapting to meet and foresee the evolving needs of our users, ensuring businesses remain compliant and confident in their operations.

Still curious? Read more about us here: About Formalize.

Ready to apply?

We will hold interviews and hire on an ongoing basis. For more information or questions, please contact the responsible recruiter in the Talent Acquisition team. Apply now with your resume and other relevant information through our Career Page. We look forward to seeing your application!

jobs.description:
About Us

nShift
is the leading global provider of cloud delivery management solutions (SaaS), we enable the frictionless shipment and return of almost one billion shipments across 190 countries each year. We are headquartered in London and Oslo and have over 460 employees across offices in Sweden, Finland, Norway, Denmark, the United Kingdom, Poland, the Netherlands, Belgium, and Romania.

Our software is used by many of the world leading e-commerce, retail, manufacturing, and 3PL shippers due to us having over 1000 carriers integrated into our platform, nearly 3 times more than our competitors!

If you buy goods online, there is a strong chance that nShift has powered that delivery, so come and join us as we shape the future of shipping, one frictionless journey at a time.

About You

We are seeking a dynamic and accomplished .NET Developer to join our talented Portal team. The ideal candidate will possess a unique blend of technical expertise in modern .NET development, frontend skills, and a passion for working with cutting-edge AI technology. As a key player in our organization, you should have a proven track record of delivering high-quality software, building scalable systems, and continuously learning new technologies.

Purpose of role

In the Portal, we're building innovative User Management, Identity Provider, SCIM solutions. This is an opportunity to contribute to an active, growing AI platform and expand its capabilities through practical, hands-on development.

We are looking for a practical, hands-on developer who will help us build, improve, and extend the chat system by implementing real features using established libraries and modern best practices.

No prior AI/LLM experience required
- we're looking for strong software engineers who are excited to learn and work with cutting-edge AI technology. If you have solid engineering fundamentals and curiosity about AI, we'll help you develop the AI-specific skills.

Your role includes:

Building and maintaining both backend (.NET) and frontend (VUE/React/TypeScript) components
Implementing AI agent features and LLM integrations using established frameworks
Developing real-time streaming conversation systems
Creating document ingestion and processing pipelines
Contributing to technical decisions and architectural improvements
Collaborating with Product Managers and the engineering team to deliver high-quality features

What You'll Be Doing

Technology

Build and maintain scalable, secure, and resilient .NET code
Develop responsive React applications with TypeScript and modern frontend practices
Integrate with multiple LLM providers (Anthropic Claude, OpenAI, AWS Bedrock)
Implement real-time streaming systems using WebSocket/SSE
Work with vector databases and RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) patterns
Ensure code quality through testing, type hints, and code reviews
Keep the technology stack up to date and follow best practices

Process

Follow established development processes and advocate for continuous improvement
Write clean, well-documented code with comprehensive tests
Participate in code reviews and knowledge-sharing sessions
Use modern development tools and practices (Git, Docker, CI/CD)
Challenge yourself and the team to enhance working methods
Contribute to technical documentation and internal education

Collaboration

Work closely with other developers, product managers, and stakeholders
Participate in planning and architectural discussions
Share knowledge and mentor team members on technical topics
Communicate effectively in English (written and spoken)
Take ownership of features from design to deployment

What You Will Bring

For the role of Software Engineer in our Portal team at nShift, we are seeking candidates who embody the following characteristics:

Technical Proficiency
: Strong hands-on experience with .NET. Experience with API design, database optimization, and system architecture thinking is essential. Experience with LLMs, AI agent frameworks, vector databases and TypeScript is a distinct advantage, but not mandatory - these can be learned on the job.

Problem-Solving Ability
: You have strong debugging and problem-solving skills, with the ability to understand complex systems and find elegant solutions.

Learning Mindset

Quality Focus

The people at UiPath believe in the transformative power of automation to change how the world works. We’re committed to creating category-leading enterprise software that unleashes that power.

jobs.description:
Spektrum supports apex purchasers (NATO, UN, EU, and National Government and Defence) and their Tier 1 supplier ecosystem with a wide range of specialist services. We provide our clients with professional services, specialised aerospace and defence sales, delivery, and operational subject matter expertise. We are looking for personnel to join our team and support key client projects.
Who we are supporting

The NATO Communication and Information Agency (NCIA) is responsible for providing secure and effective communications and information technology (IT) services to NATO's member countries and its partners. The agency was established in 2012 and is headquartered in Brussels, Belgium.
The NCIA provides a wide range of services, including:
Cyber Security: The NCIA provides advanced cybersecurity solutions to protect NATO's communication networks and information systems against cyber threats.
Command and Control Systems: The NCIA develops and maintains the systems used by NATO's military commanders to plan and execute operations.
Satellite Communications: The NCIA provides satellite communications services to enable secure and reliable communications between NATO forces.
Electronic Warfare: The NCIA provides electronic warfare services to support NATO's mission to detect, deny, and defeat threats to its communication networks.
Information Management: The NCIA manages NATO's information technology infrastructure, including its databases, applications, and servers.

Overall, the NCIA plays a critical role in ensuring the security and effectiveness of NATO's communication and information technology capabilities.
The program

Assistance and Advisory Service (AAS)

The NATO Communications and Information Agency (NCI Agency) is NATO’s principal C3 capability deliverer and CIS service provider. It provides, maintains and defends the NATO enterprise-wide information technology infrastructure to enable Allies to consult together under Article IV, and, when required, stand together in the face of attack under Article V.
To provide these critical services, in the modern evolving dynamic environment the NCI Agency needs to build and maintain high performance-engaged workforce. The NCI Agency workforce strategically consists of three major categorise's: NATO International Civilians (NIC)'s, Military (Mil), and Interim Workforce Consultants (IWC)'s. The IWCs are a critical part of the overall NCI Agency workforce and make up approximately 15 percent of the total workforce.
Software Developer

NATO International Staff requires a Software Developer – Expert Consultant
to support the Defence Planning and Policy Division, Defence Planning Directorate, Data Analysis Section
.
The role focuses on developing and maintaining solutions for data collection, analysis and visualisation
, particularly web applications and dashboards supporting defence-planning data analysis.
Role Duties and Responsibilities

Design, develop and deploy web-based dashboards.
Develop and configure web applications using modern web frameworks.
Develop and test data-collection solutions.
Transform and integrate data from classified and unclassified sources into web-based systems.
Perform data conversion and preprocessing using Python APIs and ETL tools
.
Develop and improve data-collection tools based on stakeholder requirements.
Develop and maintain documentation for code, service endpoints and system architecture.
Support security testing and approval activities.
Test solutions with stakeholders and ensure requirements are met.
Develop data-driven dashboards for senior leadership using Python and/or Power BI
.
Support workshops and stakeholder engagements.
Provide knowledge transfer and training materials.
Report on progress and identify potential project/timeline risks.
Brief NATO International Staff and leadership on project progress.

Essential Skills

JavaScript and HTML.
Modern web development frameworks such as React, Vue.js or Angular
.
MS SQL

.
Python

for automation, ETL and data analysis.
Python libraries including pandas, NumPy and Matplotlib
.
Development of data-driven dashboards using Python and/or Power BI
.
Backend services and/or data-processing pipelines.
Data integration and preprocessing.
Git/version control.
Agile project management.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Excellent communication skills.
Ability to work independently and as part of a team.

Desirable:

Practical .NET
experience

Experience

Minimum 5 years of web development experience
using JavaScript/HTML and frameworks such as React, Vue.js or Angular.
Extensive MS SQL experience.
Experience developing dashboards for senior stakeholders.
Strong Python experience for automation, ETL and analysis.
Experience building and maintaining backend services or processing pipelines.

educations and Certifications

Bachelor's Degree

in Computer Science, Data Science, Information Technology or a related field.
Advanced English.

Working Location

NATO HQ, Brussels, Belgium / Remote

The contractor has flexibility to work remotely combined with some physical presence at NATO HQ.
Working Policy

Hybrid / flexible remote working with some on-site presence in Brussels.

The contractor must be available for contact during approximately half of NATO's official working hours, taking time-zone differences into account.

Base scope: 304 hours

Option 1: 2027 – 1,672 hours

Travel to NATO HQ may occur 2–3 times during the performance period
, with travel costs included in the quoted price.
Signed NDA required.

Travel

Some travel to other NATO sites may be required

Valid National or NATO Secret personal security clearance

jobs.title: Software Engineer – Renewable Energy Platforms
jobs.description:
Join us, be part of more.

We’re so much more than an energy company. We’re a family of brands revolutionising how we power the planet. We're energisers. One team of 21,000 colleagues that’s energising a greener, fairer future by creating an energy system that doesn’t rely on fossil fuels, whilst living our powerful commitment to igniting positive change in our communities. Here, you can find more purpose, more passion and more potential. That’s why working here is #MoreThanACareer. We do energy differently – we do it all. We make it, store it, move it, sell it and mend it.

About your team:

At Centrica Energy, our mission is to move it.

We’re energy movers by nature. We’re a global renewable energy trading company which helps move energy from source to use – powering businesses, homes, and societies as they transition to a new sustainable energy future. If the idea of working to create a sustainable energy future also moves you, we may very well be the right place for you.

Technology is central to how we move energy from source to use. As a Software Engineer, you will help build and evolve the platforms that support our renewable trading business while contributing to a major effort to bring multiple systems together into a single, long-term technology foundation. Working alongside skilled engineers and business experts, you will have the opportunity to influence both the solutions we build and the direction we take next.

About The Role

We are bringing together several platforms that have supported different parts of our business over many years. As we create a more unified technology landscape, we are investing in the teams that will build, evolve, and maintain these systems for the future. This creates an exciting opportunity for experienced developers to influence both the direction of our technology and the way we work together as engineering teams.

Depending on your skills, experience, and interests, you will either join an existing team where you can quickly contribute and learn from colleagues with deep domain expertise or become part of a team focused on shaping the next generation of our platforms. We carefully match new colleagues to the environment where they are most likely to succeed, supported by a structured onboarding programme, a dedicated buddy, and experienced colleagues who will help you build domain knowledge from day one.

As part of this role, you will:

Lead the design, development, and enhancement of backend services and APIs using .NET C#.
Drive architectural decisions that ensure our solutions are scalable, secure, and maintainable.
Build and enhance desktop applications using WPF while integrating systems through modern Web APIs.
Develop resilient cloud-native solutions using AWS, Kubernetes, messaging technologies, and modern database platforms.
Mentor fellow engineers and contribute to engineering excellence through code reviews, testing practices, and continuous improvement.

About You

You are an experienced software engineer who enjoys solving complex problems and turning ideas into reliable, scalable solutions. You thrive in collaborative environments where people challenge each other, share knowledge, and work together towards a common goal. While strong technical skills are important, we're equally interested in your curiosity, judgement, and ability to help others succeed.

We're particularly interested in candidates who bring:

Significant experience developing enterprise applications using .NET C#.
Strong knowledge of modern software engineering practices, including cloud technologies, system design, and DevOps.
Proven experience designing distributed systems and making sound architectural decisions.
A passion for building maintainable, well-tested software with long-term sustainability in mind.
The ability to partner effectively with business stakeholders, alongside experience with technologies such as AWS, Kubernetes, Kafka, RabbitMQ, Datadog, MongoDB, PostgreSQL, and MSSQL.

Previous experience within energy trading is beneficial but not essential. Strong engineering capability, technical leadership, and a growth mindset matter far more than industry background.

About Centrica Energy

We are a leading energy trading and optimisation business, helping move energy from source to use across global markets. We trade power, gas, LNG, and environmental products, connecting producers, suppliers, and customers while helping make energy systems more flexible, resilient, and sustainable. We are Energy Movers by Nature, driven by our purpose of energising a greener, fairer future.

From eight offices across Europe, Asia, and North America, our teams combine market expertise, data, technology, and trading capabilities to help balance supply and demand, manage risk, and support the transition towards a more sustainable energy future. We are also one of Europe's largest renewable asset managers, with substantial renewable and flexible generation capacity under management.

Joining us means becoming part of an ambitious, international organisation where technology is central to everything we do. Together, we are building solutions that help power businesses, homes, and societies while creating the energy systems of tomorrow.

Why should you apply?

We’re not a perfect place – but we’re a people place. Our priority is supporting all of the different realities our people face. Life is about so much more than work. We get it. That’s why we’ve designed our total rewards to give you the flexibility to choose what you need, when you need it, making sure that you and your family are supported not only financially, but physically and emotionally too. Visit the link below to discover why we’re a great place to work and what being part of more means for you.

https://www.morethanacareer.energy/centricaenergy

If you're full of energy, fired up about sustainability, and ready to craft not only a better tomorrow, but a better you, then come and find your purpose in a team where your voice matters, your growth is non-negotiable, and your ambitions are our priority.

Help us, help you. We would love for you to share any information about yourself throughout our recruitment process so that we can better understand you and help shape your journey.

Assurer la conception, le développement et la maintenance de composants .NET réutilisables.

.

jobs.title: Fullstack Developer - Flutter, .NET & Connected Devices (SMARTLINK IoT Mobile)
jobs.description:
Your role

SMARTLINK is Atlas Copco's connectivity and monitoring platform for compressed air installations: more than 300,000 connected assets, over 100,000 users worldwide, billions of data points a day. For a large share of those users the mobile app is the connected ecosystem - commissioning equipment, troubleshooting a gateway that will not come online, acting on an alert - so it decides how our mobile experience is perceived, often before anyone opens the portal.

A growing part of the roadmap is device onboarding, and that makes this more than a business app: users in the field discover sensors and gateways, connect them over Bluetooth Low Energy, configure WiFi, provision equipment and troubleshoot when communication fails. Your work sits where mobile software, cloud services and physical hardware meet - flows that have to hold up when connectivity is poor, the hardware is not in a known state, and the person holding the phone is a technician on a noisy plant floor rather than a power user at a desk.

You join a product team (Product Owner, UX/UI designer, Flutter and .NET developers, test engineers) that owns the whole mobile experience from discovery to production.

You work across the whole product lifecycle rather than implementing requirements handed to you. You help understand the problem, validate the solution, build production software, and then look at whether it actually changed anything for the user.

You move between product discussions, Flutter development, backend services, APIs design and implementation, analytics and troubleshooting. One day is user journeys with the Product Owner and designer; the next is a Flutter feature, an ASP.NET Core endpoint, or working out from Mixpanel why a commissioning flow is being abandoned at step three.

You will be comfortable in a codebase with history and constraints, and you care as much about the problem as the solution - what frustrates the user in the field is as interesting to you as the architecture behind it.

In This Role, You Will

Build new capabilities for SMARTLINK Mobile in Flutter and Dart, and extend ASP.NET Core services and APIs behind them - owning a capability end to end rather than one side of it.
Take part in discovery and refinement: understand the persona and the journey, apply jobs-to-be-done thinking, and challenge a requirement before it is built rather than after.
Work with the Product Owner and designer from the first sketch, and say so when a flow does not hold once real devices and real field conditions are involved.
Build the commissioning and onboarding experiences for sensors, gateways and connected equipment.
Engineer for the field: intermittent connectivity, offline behaviour, slow networks, and failure states that tell the user what to do next instead of what went wrong.
Close the loop with data: adoption and usage in Mixpanel, system behaviour in New Relic, and commissioning success and failure rates treated as a first-class product metric.
Keep quality where it belongs: tests alongside the product code, code review, architecture discussions, and your share of production troubleshooting.
Leverage AI in your daily work and help the team keep raising the bar on how we use it.

To succeed, you will need

At Atlas Copco Group, our slogan for various positions is "hire for attitude & train for skill". We train you for these positions through on-the-job-training. Do you only partly meet the profile as outlined below? No problem! We still encourage you to apply and take this opportunity. Who knows, on-the-job-training may be available for you for this position.

You have built and shipped a mobile or fullstack product that other people depend on - not a greenfield demo, but something with history, users and constraints. You can tell the difference between a flow that is finished and one that merely works, and you are as comfortable in a product conversation as in a stack trace. We need you to hit the ground running: come in as a solid medior and grow into owning a significant part of the mobile product, or arrive senior and set the patterns the team adopts.

Your Profile Includes

Several years of hands-on software development, at a level where you own a feature end to end: design, implementation, data, and the edge cases in between.
Strong C# and .NET, including REST APIs and backend services you have designed rather than only consumed.
Production Flutter and Dart experience - an app that real users depend on, not a demo.
Modern engineering as a habit: testing next to the product code, code review, CI/CD, and a build setup you understand.
Strong analytical and root cause skills. You keep digging until you know why, not just that it failed.
Comfortable in a multidisciplinary agile team, with the confidence to say in refinement that something should not be built the way it is specified.
Fluency with AI tooling plus the judgement to verify what it produces.

Considered a Plus

Genuine interest in UX and product discovery - you want to understand how the user works, not just what to build.
Bluetooth Low Energy, WiFi provisioning or device onboarding development.
Connected devices, sensors and gateways, or industrial IoT more broadly.
Offline-first mobile applications and mobile performance work.
Analytics and observability in practice: Mixpanel, New Relic, feature flags, A/B testing.
Azure, event-driven architectures and microservices.
Firmware update workflows.

In return, we offer

At Atlas Copco Group you will join an international and diverse environment with specialists from different disciplines. Our culture is rooted in Swedish values, which includes a family feeling, respect and diversity. We invest in our employees’ development and well-being, and we provide a flexible work-life balance. With our inclusive and caring environment, you get the support and inspiration you need to grow.

You will benefit from a comprehensive onboarding program, including guidance by a personal godmother/godfather. As part of the Atlas Copco Group, you will also have access to global career opportunities. We offer a competitive compensation and benefits package, including health insurance, paid leave and retirement benefits.

Job location

This role offers a hybrid working arrangement, allowing you to split your time between working remotely and being on-site at our Atlas Copco airpower site in Wilrijk, Belgium (BE).

Uniting curious minds

Behind every innovative solution, there are people working together to transform the future. With careers sparked by initiative and lifelong learning, we unite curious minds, and you could be one of them.

Cyber Security: The NCIA provides advanced cybersecurity solutions to protect NATO's communication networks and information systems against cyber threats.

Electronic Warfare: The NCIA provides electronic warfare services to support NATO's mission to detect, deny, and defeat threats to its communication networks.

Technical Problem Solving Analyze complex technical issues, evaluate multiple solutions, and apply sound judgment to resolve problems effectively.

Collaboration & Communication Work closely with product, QA, and other engineering teams; explain complex technical topics clearly and contribute to alignment and consensus.

Advanced knowledge of:

Angular

Redis

Experiencia con especificaciones OpenAPI 3.x y Swagger 2.0

Herramientas como Azure DevOps y Application Insights

Idiomas

Nivel de inglés fluido, imprescindible

jobs.title: Solution Architect
jobs.location: Greater Palma de Mallorca Metropolitan Area
jobs.description:
Siemens, a global leader with over 175 years of history, made a revolutionary move 7 years ago with the creation of Siemens Advanta, its specialized division in consulting and digital transformation. As a trusted advisor, Siemens Advanta forms lasting partnerships with clients, guiding them on their journey towards the digitalization and modernization of their organizations.

We are the catalyst for the digital transformation of the industrial world, unlocking the digital future of our clients by offering end-to-end support in their unique digitalization journey.

The Iberia region has consolidated itself as one of the most dynamic and promising markets for Siemens Advanta, with significant investment in resources and capabilities.

We currently have a team of over 100 highly qualified professionals offering professional services structured into three fundamental areas:

Consulting: Helping clients understand their digital maturity, create an evolution plan based on their priorities, improve production excellence, process improvement, define business digitalization, and reduce costs.
Digital Solution Design: Understanding client needs and transforming them into technological solutions (both IT and OT).
Digital Solution Implementation: Implementing software development applications, data platforms, Cloud & On-Prem infrastructures, reporting systems, LowCode applications, etc.

Your Role

We are looking for a Solution Architect – Software to join our growing team in Iberia. As a Solution Architect, you will be a senior technical leader responsible for designing, shaping, and governing the architecture of transformative software solutions. You will bridge business requirements with technical execution, lead multidisciplinary engineering teams, shape strategic customer opportunities, drive pre-sales initiatives, and mentor technical talent to build organizational capability.

Your mission will be to define end-to-end solution architectures that are technically sound, scalable, secure, and aligned with business objectives and Siemens governance requirements. You will act as a strategic technical authority across solution design, architecture definition, and customer-critical engagements.

Your Responsibilities

Define and govern end-to-end solution architectures across software, cloud, data, and AI-enabled initiatives, ensuring strategic alignment with organizational capabilities
Translate business requirements and strategic objectives into technically feasible solution designs, architecture blueprints, and implementation approaches
Lead architecture definition across application layers, data flows, integration patterns, security requirements, and operational considerations
Provide senior technical leadership to multidisciplinary teams, guiding complex technical decisions and delivery challenges
Shape strategic customer solutions by defining technical approaches that drive business value and competitive advantage
Support pre-sales and proposal activities contributing to technical estimates, feasibility analysis, and executive-ready documentation
Communicate and defend architectural designs to executive stakeholders, translating complex technical concepts into business implications
Mentor and coach technical team members supporting capability development, architectural maturity, and professional growth
Manage project budgets and timelines ensuring financial and schedule viability
Ensure solutions meet agreed standards for scalability, performance, resilience, cybersecurity, data privacy, and operational readiness

What You Offer

Education:

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or comparable technical discipline

Experience:

8-10+ years of relevant professional experience as a Software Architect, Senior Software Engineer, or in similar senior technical leadership roles
Proven experience designing, delivering, and leading complex technology solutions in multidisciplinary environments with strategic customer engagement
Demonstrated technical leadership guiding multiple development teams and making architectural decisions
Experience with Generative AI, AI-enabled solutions, AI-assisted software engineering, and intelligent automation
Proven ability to lead technical discussions with senior stakeholders and shape strategic customer solutions
Experience contributing to pre-sales activities, proposals, and solution concepts with demonstrated business impact

Technical Skills:

Expert-level knowledge in end-to-end solution architecture and strategic design
Advanced proficiency in cloud architecture (Microsoft Azure, AWS, Google Cloud), microservices, and cloud-native architectures
Strong expertise in data architecture, API design, integration patterns, DevOps, and security principles
Generative AI, AI-enabled solutions, and intelligent automation architectures
Technology selection and architecture trade-off analysis

Technical Knowledge (High Level Required):

Project Management & Technical Leadership
Microsoft Azure
SQL
Excel and PowerPoint
AI/ML Concepts and Generative AI
Professional Certifications (cloud, architecture, or AI-related) – Required

Competencies:

Strategic and systems thinking with business acumen
Technical leadership and ability to influence senior stakeholders and multidisciplinary teams
Clear communication of complex technical concepts to diverse audiences
Ownership and accountability for solution integrity and business outcomes
Coaching, mentoring, and organizational capability building
Learning agility and adaptability to emerging technologies
Executive presence and strategic customer engagement
Professional reliability, integrity, and sound judgment

Language:

Advanced level of English (oral and written)
Spanish or other European languages are an advantage

What We Offer

At Siemens Advanta, we believe that great results start with great people. That's why we offer attractive working conditions in an environment where you are truly valued — with flexible working hours, a flexible remuneration plan, and a wide range of benefits and measures designed with our team in mind. Beyond the perks, what makes this opportunity truly unique is the chance to be a founding pillar of something bold and ambitious in Iberia, contributing to one of the most exciting energy revolutions of our generation at the very moment where strategy meets action. We also invest in your growth through training and technical certifications, because we know that your development and our success go hand in hand.

If you are passionate about technology, innovation, and making a positive impact on the global energy transition, this is your place. Apply now and be part of the team that is building the digital future of energy!

jobs.title: Senior Solution Architect
jobs.description:
AVEVA is creating software trusted by over 90% of leading industrial companies.

Job Title:
Principal Solution Architect (PI Data Infrastructure / CONNECT Digital Twin)

Location:
Cambridge, UK or Madrid, Spain

Employment Type:
Full-time, hybrid role

The job

We are looking for a Principal Solution Architect to lead architecture, solution design, and customer engagement for PI Data Infrastructure and AVEVA CONNECT Digital Twin initiatives. This role will work with global and regional teams to deliver scalable, value-driven industrial data solutions across sectors such as energy, mining, utilities, manufacturing, chemicals, and data centres. You will act as a trusted advisor to customers and internal teams, helping translate business needs into robust technical architectures and successful delivery outcomes.

Key Responsibilities

Lead solution architecture, workshops, implementation planning, and technical design for PI Data Infrastructure and CONNECT Digital Twin customer programmes
Engage with customers to gather requirements, manage stakeholders, and act as a trusted advisor and escalation point for PI DI initiatives
Define architecture standards, templates, best practices, and rollout approaches for multi-site or enterprise deployments
Collaborate with product management, services, sales, pre-sales, and delivery teams to shape customer value, identify new use cases, and provide product feedback
Mentor and guide multi-disciplinary teams, including solution architects, senior engineers, developers, UX specialists, and industry experts

Essential Requirements

15+ years of relevant experience in solution architecture, consulting, services delivery, or industrial software implementation
Deep experience with PI Data Infrastructure, including PI Server installation, configuration, connectivity, protocols, alerting, aggregation, Asset Framework, PI Vision, and PI DataLink
Strong industrial domain experience in sectors such as energy, mining, data centres, utilities, chemicals, manufacturing, or other asset-intensive environments
Proven ability to lead customer workshops, translate requirements into clear system designs, and communicate effectively with IT, OT, plant leadership, and business stakeholders
Experience leading or supporting global or regional industrial data programmes across multiple plants or sites

Desired Skills And Competencies

Experience with AVEVA CONNECT capabilities, including CONNECT Data, sharing, analytics, visualisation, digital twin, DataOps, and AI/ML-enabled use cases
Strong understanding of SCADA systems, PI Interfaces and Connectors, OPC DA/UA, Modbus, DCS systems, and industrial automation data connectivity
Experience with AF SDK/.NET, PI system administration, archive management, PI calculations, troubleshooting, backups, and operational dashboard design
Ability to map customer KPIs and use cases, such as operational efficiency, compliance, sustainability, asset monitoring, CBM, and data consolidation, to PI DI and CONNECT value outcomes
Experience supporting pre-sales, solution estimation, proposal development, project risk management, and partner or capability-building initiatives

Services at AVEVA

Our dynamic global team of 700+ engineers, developers, consultants, solution architects and project managers are at the forefront of delivering AVEVA cutting-edge solutions to customers. The work is complex and technical, but immensely rewarding: we empower customers to harness the full transformative potential of AVEVA’s solutions. If you’re analytical, pragmatic, and driven to make a tangible impact on the sustainability of the industrial sector, our team is the perfect place for you.

Find out more: https://www.aveva.com/en/about/careers/

UK Benefits include:

Flexible benefits fund, emergency leave days, adoption leave, 28 days annual leave (plus bank holidays), pension, life cover, private medical insurance, parental leave, education assistance program.

It’s possible we’re hiring for this position in multiple countries, in which case the above benefits apply to the primary location. Specific benefits vary by country, but our packages are similarly comprehensive.

Find out more: aveva.com/en/about/careers/benefits/

Hybrid working

We work in a hybrid way at AVEVA. Most roles are based at a local AVEVA office, with an expectation of being on-site 50% of your working hours to support collaboration and connection. Some positions are fully office-based depending on the nature of the work, and certain roles that support specific customers or markets may be remote. The working arrangement for this position will be confirmed during the hiring process.

Hiring process

Interested? Great! Get started by submitting your cover letter and CV through our application portal. AVEVA is committed to recruiting and retaining people with disabilities. Please let us know in advance if you need reasonable support during your application process.

Find out more: aveva.com/en/about/careers/hiring-process

About AVEVA

AVEVA is a global leader in industrial software with more than 6,500 employees in over 40 countries. Our cutting-edge solutions are used by thousands of enterprises to deliver the essentials of life – such as energy, infrastructure, chemicals, and minerals – safely, efficiently, and more sustainably.

We are committed to embedding sustainability and inclusion into our operations, our culture, and our core business strategy. Learn more about how we are progressing against our ambitious 2030 targets: sustainability-report.aveva.com/

Find out more: aveva.com/en/about/careers/

AVEVA requires all successful applicants to undergo and pass a drug screening and comprehensive background check before they start employment. Background checks will be conducted in accordance with local laws and may, subject to those laws, include proof of educational attainment, employment history verification, proof of work authorization, criminal records, identity verification, credit check. jobs.title: Engineering Manager, Client (Unity) - Unannounced Project
jobs.description:
Scopely is looking for an Engineering Manager, Client (Unity) to join our new unannounced project in Barcelona, Spain to work on a hybrid basis 3 times a week. We can support with visa sponsorship and relocation support

At Scopely, we care deeply about what we do and want to inspire play, every day - whether in our work environments alongside our talented colleagues, or through our deep connections with our communities of players. We are a distributed team of game enthusiasts who are developing, publishing, and innovating in the mobile games industry, connecting millions of people around the world every day

We embrace AI-forward development practices and expect our engineers to be curious and pragmatic about how these tools can raise the bar

We are in the development stages of a bold, unannounced, cross-platform Strategy/MMO title. We are looking for passionate game makers to collaborate, get in early and make their mark on this exciting venture

What You Will Do

Lead and manage a team of experienced engineers who focus on developing and maintaining the game client
Design and implement new features in our game client, working collaboratively with other stakeholder teams to understand requirements and identify the best technical solutions
Propose and implement improvements to our development processes, workflows and tools, to increase efficiency, quality and throughput
Conduct pair programming, code reviews, 1-1’s and knowledge sharing sessions to enhance skills and build a strong development culture
Work closely with QA to resolve bugs and deliver high-quality code for testing, contributing directly to the code base
Be the quality gate for all code that goes into our game. Keep the team writing clean, efficient and optimized code
Work with stakeholders to figure out and implement the best alternative technical solutions
Leverage AI tools and agentic workflows in your daily work — from tech planning, code generation and review to exploring novel solutions

What We’re Looking For

Have technically led or managed a team (any size really)
Proven ability to engage and motivate, to bring out the best in people
Experienced being part of a professional development team working on game client features or other relevant areas
Familiarity with software development methodologies such as Agile and Scrum
Excellent experience working with multiple stakeholders in the development process - be able to understand their goals, and deliver/ evaluate various tech solutions to meet these
Strong technical skills and experience in at least one of the following areas: game engines, rendering engines, networking, physics, AI, audio
Excellent programming skills in C# or C++
Experience in mobile and/or PC game development
Experience with version control, build tools and deployment pipelines
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
Strong communication and collaboration skills to work effectively with cross-functional teams
Knowledge of software engineering best practices and trends
Hands-on experience working with AI-assisted development tools (e.g. GitHub Copilot, Codex, Claude Code) and an understanding of how agentic workflows can augment engineering productivity.

Bonus points

Experience with automated testing and continuous integration
Experience with cloud technologies and services for game development
Knowledge of game design principles and user experience

About Scopely

Scopely is a leading video game and global interactive entertainment company, home to many of the world’s most beloved and enduring experiences, including two of the most successful mobile games of all-time “MONOPOLY GO!” and “Pokémon GO,” along with “Stumble Guys,” “Star Trek™ Fleet Command,” “MARVEL Strike Force,” “WWE Champions,” the Scrabble® franchise, “Yahtzee® With Buddies,” and many others. Across mobile, web, PC, and console, Scopely creates, develops, publishes, and live-operates one of the most diversified and award-winning portfolios in the games industry — bringing hundreds of millions of players together through a shared love of play.

Founded in 2011, Scopely is powered by its exceptional team — including thousands of world-class gamemakers around the globe, a distinctive tenet-driven culture, and its proprietary technology platform, Playgami. Together, these strengths have fueled Scopely’s position as the #1 mobile games company in the U.S. and #2 globally, generating more than $10 billion in lifetime revenue. Whether building global sensations like “MONOPOLY GO!” from the ground up, or expanding through strategic acquisitions, including the FoxNext, GSN, and Scopely Explore games businesses — Scopely consistently delivers experiences players love today and return to for years to come.

Recognized multiple times as one of the "100 Most Influential Companies in the World" by TIME magazine and one of Fast Company's "World's Most Innovative Companies" and “Best Workplaces for Innovators,” Scopely believes that video games can be a force for good — creating meaningful connections, vibrant communities, and making life better through play.

Scopely has global operations and partners across four continents in more than a dozen countries worldwide. For more information, visit: https://www.scopely.com/.

Should you have any questions or encounter any fraudulent requests/emails/websites, please immediately contact recruiting@scopely.com. Our job applicant privacy policies are available here: California Privacy Notice and EEA/UK Privacy Notice.

jobs.title: Azure Cloud Architect
jobs.description:
NTT DATA
es una consultora multinacional que ofrece soluciones tecnológicas, de negocio, estrategia, desarrollo y mantenimiento de aplicaciones, siendo un referente en consultoría.

Digital Technology
es la unidad enfocada a acompañar a las grandes organizaciones iberoamericanas en su transformación digital, generando dividendos digitales a través de la tecnología y el diseño, con enfoque práctico y orientado al negocio. Para lograrlo, buscamos personas que compartan nuestra curiosidad permanente, pasión por la tecnología, excelencia constante y visión estratégica.

Digital Architecture
es la división que proporciona la estrategia tecnológica y las plataformas IT necesarias para impulsar la digitalización y transformación de nuestros clientes, ofreciendo soluciones cloud-native y siendo referentes en la construcción de arquitecturas robustas, seguras y que contemplen todas las necesidades.

Estamos ampliando nuestro equipo de arquitectura en Azure
y buscamos perfiles capaces de diseñar soluciones que combinen innovación, gobierno y fiabilidad operativa. Personas con criterio para conectar necesidades de negocio, requisitos regulatorios y decisiones tecnológicas, construyendo arquitecturas preparadas para evolucionar. Como Microsoft Gold Partner
, en NTT DATA impulsamos soluciones sobre Azure que combinan innovación tecnológica, gobierno y cumplimiento normativo. Trabajamos en proyectos donde la nube debe integrarse de forma realista con entornos existentes, modernizar aplicaciones críticas y habilitar plataformas empresariales escalables, seguras y conectadas con el ecosistema Microsoft.

¿Qué nos gustaría que aportaras?
Aunque no todo es imprescindible, nos gustaría que contaras con:
Al menos 5 años de experiencia diseñando y evolucionando arquitecturas cloud sobre Microsoft Azure
, en entornos empresariales complejos.
Conocimiento sólido de los servicios esenciales de Azure para el diseño de soluciones: identidad, redes, cómputo, almacenamiento, bases de datos, integración, observabilidad, seguridad y gobierno.
Experiencia aplicando principios del Microsoft Azure Well-Architected Framework
y definiendo arquitecturas escalables, resilientes, seguras y eficientes.
Capacidad para diseñar y evolucionar entornos híbridos, conectando Azure con infraestructuras on-premise , otras nubes y el ecosistema Microsoft.
Experiencia en la definición de landing zones , modelos de gobierno, estructuras de suscripciones, políticas, gestión de identidades y controles de cumplimiento.
Conocimiento de estrategias de modernización y migración de aplicaciones, valorando alternativas basadas en servicios PaaS, contenedores, arquitecturas serverless o plataformas gestionadas.
Criterio para abordar decisiones de seguridad y cumplimiento: Microsoft Entra ID, gestión de secretos, segmentación de red, cifrado, monitorización, auditoría y protección de cargas.
Capacidad para colaborar con equipos de ingeniería, plataformas, ciberseguridad, datos y responsables de negocio, facilitando decisiones técnicas alineadas con los objetivos del proyecto.

También valoraremos positivamente:
Certificaciones de Microsoft Azure, especialmente Azure Solutions Architect Expert
, o experiencia práctica alineada con sus dominios de conocimiento.
Experiencia con infraestructura como código y automatización mediante Terraform, Bicep, ARM Templates o Azure DevOps.
Conocimiento de Azure Kubernetes Service, Azure Landing Zones, Azure Arc, plataformas de integración, arquitecturas orientadas a eventos o prácticas DevSecOps.
Participación en iniciativas de gobierno cloud, optimización de costes, Cloud Center of Excellence o evolución de modelos operativos.
Interés por las capacidades de datos e inteligencia artificial del ecosistema Azure y por su integración en arquitecturas empresariales.

¿Cuáles serán tus responsabilidades?
Diseñar arquitecturas objetivo en Azure que respondan a necesidades de negocio y equilibren seguridad, escalabilidad, disponibilidad, rendimiento, gobierno y coste.
Definir patrones, estándares y arquitecturas de referencia reutilizables para acelerar el diseño y la adopción de soluciones cloud.
Diseñar y evolucionar landing zones , modelos de gobierno y controles técnicos que permitan utilizar Azure de forma segura, ordenada y escalable.
Acompañar proyectos de modernización, migración e integración híbrida, ayudando a seleccionar el enfoque tecnológico más adecuado para cada caso.
Evaluar decisiones de arquitectura, identificar riesgos y proponer alternativas ante retos de conectividad, identidad, integración, cumplimiento o operación.
Colaborar con equipos de desarrollo, plataformas y ciberseguridad para asegurar que los diseños se llevan a la práctica de forma consistente y sostenible.
Facilitar conversaciones entre equipos técnicos y responsables de negocio, transformando necesidades complejas en decisiones de arquitectura y roadmaps accionables.
Contribuir al desarrollo de la práctica de Azure mediante la compartición de conocimiento, la creación de activos reutilizables y la exploración de capacidades relevantes del ecosistema Microsoft.

📍 Aunque nuestra búsqueda está centrada principalmente en Madrid, también tenemos equipos en Barcelona, Coruña, Bilbao, Oviedo, Sevilla, Valencia, Valladolid y Zaragoza. Por lo que si vives en estas u otras ciudades también nos interesa tu perfil y estaremos encantados de conocerte.

¿Qué te ofrecemos?
🧠 Formar parte de un equipo de élite especializado en la unión entre estrategia y tecnología.
💼 Contrato indefinido con revisiones de categoría y salario de manera anual.
🎓 Certificaciones bonificadas de los principales proveedores cloud (AWS, Azure, GCP) y otras tecnologías.
📝 Acceso gratuito a nuestra plataforma formativa, NTT DATA University , donde encontrarás formaciones técnicas, metodológicas, idiomas y soft skills.
💻 Trabajo híbrido y horario flexible para facilitar la conciliación.
📅 Jornada intensiva (8:00 a 15:00) los viernes y los meses de verano.
🏥 Beneficios corporativos: complementos salariales adicionales, retribución flexible, seguro médico, seguro de vida y accidentes y muchos más.
🌊 Programas solidarios y actividades sociales para impulsar un impacto positivo a través de nuestro portal de voluntarios The Blue Wave .
🔝 Un ambiente de trabajo excelente, que fomenta el compañerismo y la buena convivencia. Somos Global Top Employer 2025, y, en España, por 10º año consecutivo.
🌏 Innovación diversa y cultura inclusiva. En NTT DATA creemos que cada persona es única y apostamos por una cultura que valora la diversidad y fomenta un entorno donde todos podamos explorar y potenciar nuestra singularidad.

¡Únete al equipo de Digital Technology en NTT DATA!

Trusted Advisor: Act as the main technical point of contact for the client’s IT leadership team, aligning infrastructure choices with business goals.
Mentorship: Guide and mentor junior team members within the Avanade delivery unit.
Cost Optimization: Monitor cloud spends and resource utilization using Azure Advisor and Microsoft Cost Management to deliver FinOps recommendations.

You will join the managed services team of a global technology company in Sofia, which runs the database platforms of 5–6 client organisations end to end. As the senior database engineer, you are theL3 expert for Microsoft SQL Server, and you also work hands-on on an Oracle estate of more than 50 instances (about 25 TB, mostly 19c, including RAC).

The team is cross-skilled: MS SQL Server is the main technology, and you are expected to understand how things work in Oracle and to operate it confidently.

Your Responsibilities

Act as the L3 expert for MS SQL Server across 5–6 client environments.
Administer and troubleshoot Always On Availability Groups, Failover Cluster Instances, replication and standalone instances.
Analyse and tune performance: queries, indexes, waits, blocking and resource use.
Run backup and recovery with native and third-party tools; test restores regularly.
Apply cumulative updates, upgrades and security hardening; manage logins and permissions.
Operate Oracle 19c SE/EE databases on Linux and Windows, including RAC, Grid Infrastructure and RMAN backups with a third-party backup tool.
Handle incidents, problems, changes and service requests under ITIL, in and out of business hours; record all work in ServiceNow.
Carry out proactive work: health checks, capacity reviews, backup verification and documentation.
Automate recurring tasks with T-SQL, PowerShell (e.g. dbatools) or Ansible.
Manage vendor cases with Microsoft and Oracle on behalf of the client’s customers.

Our Requirements

6+ years as an MS SQL Server DBA in production, with several years at expert (L3) level.
Hands-on experience with Always On Availability Groups, Failover Cluster Instances and

replication.

Strong performance tuning, backup and recovery skills.
2+ years hands-on Oracle administration, including 19c, RAC and RMAN.
Working-level Windows Server and Linux administration.
T-SQL and PowerShell scripting.
Working in ITIL processes with ServiceNow or a comparable ITSM tool.
Fluent English, written and spoken (C1).
Resident in Bulgaria and able to work from Bulgaria only.
Willing to take part in the standby rotation.

Standby and out-of-hours

You join the client team’s standby rotation for your technology: one to two slots per week, 12 hours on weekdays and 24 hours at weekends, with no more than 100 standby hours per month.
Standby is remote. Alerts arrive by phone from the first-line team, and you connect within the response target (15 minutes for critical incidents).
Planned change and maintenance work outside business hours is scheduled in advance, typically 5–15 hours per month.
Standby hours and out-of-hours work are compensated separately from the day rate.

jobs.title: Full-Stack Developer — Taxx.lu
jobs.description:
Role overview

Want to join the team that revolutionised tax filing in Luxembourg?
Are you looking for a new challenge in a small, fast-moving team, where your work has a real and direct impact on the lives of Luxembourg taxpayers?
Since 2018, taxx.lu has been the leader in online tax filing in Luxembourg. Our platform allows everyone to file their Luxembourg tax return as simply, quickly and reliably as possible.
To continue growing our team, we are now looking for a full-stack developer
to build the application behind it. You will help us build reliable, secure and well-structured features that support the filing experience, our support team and our AI-enabled capabilities.
This is a hands-on role, combining feature development, code review and close collaboration with Product and our tax specialists.

Your responsibilities

Build and maintain features ·        Design, develop and maintain features across the application, from data model to interface.
·        Translate Luxembourg tax rules and annual regulatory changes into working product, together with Product and our tax specialists.
·        Turn requirements into clear specifications with explicit scope and acceptance criteria.
·        Contribute to the evolution of the platform's architecture.

Write and review code to the same standard ·        Review pull requests, whether written by a colleague or generated by an agent.
·        Investigate and fix defects reported in production: reproduce, isolate and correct the cause.
·        Improve the reliability, performance and security of existing code.
·        Refactor where complexity accumulates and keep the application maintainable as it grows.

Develop with AI AI is becoming an increasingly important part of our technology landscape.
You will contribute to making agent-assisted development reliable and to defining the conventions and guardrails that agents work from, while ensuring appropriate quality, security and human oversight. We expect the same engineering principles whether code is written by a person or generated by an agent: version control, testing, code reviews, monitoring, automated deployments, documentation and maintainable solutions.

What we are looking for We are more interested in engineering fundamentals than in experience with one particular framework.

Essential skills ·        Demonstrable experience building and shipping web applications, whether professionally, through open-source work or through substantial personal projects.
·        Solid understanding of web application architecture and of common patterns such as MVC.
·        Experience with relational data modelling, migrations and SQL.
·        Good command of web fundamentals: HTTP and REST, authentication and authorisation, sessions, background jobs, caching.
·        Experience with automated testing, and an understanding of what to test at which level.
·        Ability to read and debug code written by others, including in production.
·        Ability to plan a feature: decompose it, define acceptance criteria and anticipate edge cases.
·        Practical experience working with AI coding agents.
·        Comfortable with Git and modern engineering practices.
·        Ability to work autonomously and collaborate with both technical and non-technical colleagues.
·        Professional English.

Nice to have ·        Ruby and Ruby on Rails.
·        PostgreSQL.
·        Tailwind CSS.
·        Heroku and AWS.
·        GitHub Actions and CI/CD pipelines.
·        Devise or another authentication framework.
·        Experience introducing coding agents into a team's workflow.
·        Knowledge of Luxembourg personal taxation.
·        French, German or Luxembourgish.
Experience with Rails is an advantage rather than a requirement. We allow for a proper learning period on our stack and on Luxembourg tax matters, and we expect you to be contributing to production code within your first weeks.

The profile we value We are looking for someone who:
·        Cares about correctness and about how the product is experienced by the user.
·        Plans before implementing, and is comfortable defining what is in and out of scope.
·        Takes ownership of what they build, including in production.
·        Values simple, maintainable architectures.
·        Is curious about developments in AI-assisted engineering and pragmatic about their limits.
·        Enjoys working in a lean, collaborative environment with short decision paths.

What we offer With more than 25 years on the Luxembourg market, atHome Group is a leading operator of digital platforms that support people through major life decisions — property, mobility, financing and tax — through the atHome, Luxauto, atHome Finance and taxx brands.
Driven by innovation, data and people-centred digitalisation, our mission is to make life decisions simpler, more efficient and less stressful.

The role offers the opportunity to: ·        Work on a product with a direct impact on taxpayers in Luxembourg, with a clear annual rhythm around the filing season.
·        Take technical ownership within a lean team with short decision paths.
·        Help shape how AI is adopted in our development lifecycle.
·        Build expertise in Luxembourg personal taxation.
·        Work in a flexible environment in Luxembourg, on a permanent full-time contract.

Recruitment process ·        Applications open until October 31st.
·        Introductory interview with HR.
·        Technical deep dive: review of a real issue and pull request from our codebase.
·        Final interview with leadership.

new_jobs.title: .NET Engineer
new_jobs.description:
Jouw functie

PGGM ontwikkelt veel van haar software zelf. Deze maatwerkoplossingen zijn een essentieel onderdeel van onze dienstverlening én een cruciale succesfactor voor de toekomst. Met belangrijke uitdagingen zoals de implementatie van de nieuwe pensioenwetgeving staan we voor complexe technische- en architectuurvraagstukken.

Als .NET DevOps Engineer ontwerp en bouw je hoogwaardige .NET oplossingen en generieke services binnen een complex landschap van maatwerkapplicaties, ingekochte pakketten, een BI‑-platform en diverse portalen. Jij brengt software‑ engineeringsvakmanschap samen met architectuurinzicht en neemt end‑-‑to-end ‑verantwoordelijkheid voor jouw oplossingen.

Je werkt nauw samen met de Lead developer, softwarearchitecten en andere engineers aan het toekomstbestendig maken van onze applicaties en ondersteunt de beweging naar de Azure Cloud. Je maakt technische keuzes op basis van feiten, ontwerpprincipes en standaarden.

Wat je gaat doen~

Ontwerpen, bouwen en verbeteren van robuuste .NET applicaties, services en integraties;
Toepassen van DDD, onion architecture, integratiepatronen en dependency injection;
Realiseren van REST ‑API’s en complexe koppelingen in een divers applicatielandschap;
Bijdragen aan architectuurkeuzes, kwaliteit, consistentie en technische standaarden;
End-‑to-end ‑verantwoordelijkheid~ analyse → bouwen → testen → releasen → run & observe;
Versterken van CI/CD, automatisering, security-by-design (o.a. RBAC) en observability (ELK);
Coachend optreden richting minder ervaren engineers door reviews, pairing en het demonstreren van best practices;
Samenwerken met architectuur, Cloud Enablement, Product Owners en andere engineeringdisciplines voor team overstijgende oplossingen.

Engineering Mindset~
jij bent de drijvende kracht achter topkwaliteit

Bij PB‑IT zoeken we een DevOps Engineer die méér brengt dan techniek alleen. Onze Engineering Mindset bestaande uit Samenwerking, Nieuwsgierigheid, Vakmanschap, Energie en Eigenaarschap is de manier waarop jij het verschil maakt.

Je werkt soepel team overstijgend samen en brengt mensen bij elkaar om de flow in de keten te versnellen. Je blijft nieuwsgierig, stelt scherpe vragen en initieert verbeteringen die echt waarde toevoegen. Met jouw vakmanschap ben je een inhoudelijk autoriteit~ je maakt doordachte keuzes, bewaakt kwaliteit en helpt collega’s groeien door jouw voorbeeldgedrag. Je straalt energie uit, brengt focus en creëert momentum zodat teams met vertrouwen vooruitkomen. En je neemt eigenaarschap over de hele keten~ je bouwt, levert, monitort én verbetert zonder dat iemand je erom hoeft te vragen.

Als DevOps engineer ben jij de verbindende kracht die richting geeft, kwaliteit verhoogt en onze engineering naar een hoger niveau tilt.

Jouw afdeling

Met circa 1.850 collega’s verzorgen wij de pensioenadministratie voor 5,6 miljoen Nederlanders, waarvan 2,8 miljoen in Zorg & Welzijn. Met een vermogen van €252 miljard onder beheer behoren we tot de grootste institutionele beleggers ter wereld.

Cluster Deelnemers is de Robin Hood van de IT Clusters. Daar waar het Werkgevers Cluster zorgt dat geld binnenkomt zorgt het Deelnemers cluster dat elke deelnemer krijgt waar hij/zij recht op heeft. Met €1,1 miljard euro jaarlijks uitgekeerd is het belangrijk dat we zaken goed en zorgvuldig voor elkaar hebben.

Onze missie~ mensen helpen bij het realiseren van een waardevolle en zorgeloze toekomst. Duurzaamheid, maatschappelijke relevantie en betrouwbaarheid staan daarbij centraal.

PGGM zoekt versterking bij het toekennen team~

Team Toekennen opereert zowel aan de voor- als achterkant van de keten rondom de pensioenadministratie. Toekennen is, zoals je zou verwachten, verantwoordelijk voor de toekenning van een pensioen aan een deelnemer. Als centrale applicatie in het landschap heb je een belangrijke taak als team. Niet alleen om alles draaiende en functioneel juist te hebben maar ook als keyteam in het proces. Als onderdeel van het cluster Deelnemers draag je samen met ons bij aan de administratie van meerdere fondsen en werk je intensief samen met collega’s uit de business om processen soepel en zorgvuldig te laten verlopen. We zijn een groeiend backend-team van ongeveer 10–15 collega’s, waarin leergierigheid, flexibiliteit en samenwerking centraal staan. We zoeken actief de verbinding met andere teams op en pakken graag kansen om te innoveren waar mogelijk. Onze gezamenlijke drive is om continu te verbeteren en bij te dragen aan een toekomstbestendige pensioenketen.

Het team is van A tot Z verantwoordelijk is voor het ontwikkelen en beheren van functionaliteiten die door de product owner voor dat domein worden geprioriteerd. Daarbij werk je naar (voorlopige) resultaten toe, met een flexibele aanpak. Je werkt met een Microsoft toolstack met tools als Azure Devops, SQL Server, Visual Studio (C#) en MS Test. Hiermee bouwen en onderhouden we onze software. Software die we regelmatig naar productie brengen via een geautomatiseerde pipeline.

Jouw achtergrond

Als DevOps Engineer neem jij sowieso dit mee~

HBO of WO werk- en denkniveau, bij voorkeur met IT-achtergrond;
Minimaal 5 jaar relevante ervaring in .NET softwareontwikkeling;
Ervaring met .NET (Core), Entity Framework, REST, MS SQL;
Ervaring met DDD, architectuurpatronen, integratiepatronen, DI, onion architecture;
Kennis van Azure, MS Build/Pipelines, Git, testautomatisering en RBAC-principes;
Eerder gewerkt in Agile/Scrum DevOps‑context;
Ervaring met of zicht op cloudtransities (Azure);
Uitstekende beheersing van de Nederlandse en Engelse taal.

Verder vinden we het belangrijk dat~

Je bent in staat om team overstijgend te denken in keten, architectuur en standaarden;
Je kan technische keuzes onderbouwen, uitleggen en verdedigen wanneer nodig;
Je zet de standaard voor professioneel engineer‑gedrag;
Je stuurt op kwaliteit, flow en samenwerking in de keten;
Je hebt een sterke stem in techniek.

Wij bieden

Bij PGGM zijn we trots op onze kernwaarden~ vertrouwen, teamwork en innovatie. Deze waarden zijn ontstaan uit de ‘best stories’ van onze collega's, momenten waarop zij op hun best waren. We geloven dat die momenten ontstaan wanneer je 100% jezelf kunt zijn. Bij PGGM waarderen we de unieke combinatie van jouw persoonlijke en professionele eigenschappen. Want wat echt telt bij PGGM zijn mensen, honderd procent! Bij PGGM mag jij rekenen op~

Een fijne werkplek op ons kantoor in Zeist/Den Haag en vanaf medio 2028 in hartje Utrecht.
Een bruto maandsalaris, in schaal schaal 15, tussen € 4.101,- en € 5.859,- op basis van 36 uur, afhankelijk van je kennis en ervaring.
Vakantiegeld en een dertiende maand.
Een goede pensioenregeling als deelnemer van pensioenfonds PFZW (71% betaald door PGGM, 29% door de medewerker).
Jaarlijks een Fit for the Future budget van € 300,- netto welke je kunt inzetten voor het verbeteren van de mentale, fysieke of financiële fitheid.
Een ruim opleidingsbudget voor interne en externe trainingen of opleidingen.
Ruim 26 vakantiedagen (medewerkers hebben de keuze om maximaal twee nationale christelijke feestdagen te ruilen met een voor hen belangrijke (feest)dag).
Flexibiliteit in werktijden en thuiswerkmogelijkheden.
Een netto internetvergoeding van € 45,- per maand (€ 540,- per jaar).
Collectiviteitskorting op de aanvullende zorgverzekeringen.
Een thuiswerkregeling met een vergoeding van max. € 900,- incl. btw om je thuiswerkplek arbo-proof in te richten.

Meer informatie over onze arbeidsvoorwaarden en salarisschalen lees je hier~ link

Meer weten?

Is dit jouw nieuwe baan bij PGGM?

Wil jij samen met ons de verantwoordelijkheid dragen voor een goed pensioen van ruim 5,6 miljoen pensioendeelnemers? Solliciteer dan op deze vacature. Heb je vragen? Neem dan contact op met recruiter Daphne Maasland via daphne.maasland@pggm.nl

Informatie over de sollicitatieprocedure vind je terug op onze website~ Onze sollicitatieprocedure. | PGGM.

Sollicitatieprocedure

Voor deze vacature gebruikt PGGM tijdens de screening een assessment. Alle sollicitanten voor de vacature van .NET Engineer
zullen een link ontvangen om een assessment te maken. Nadat wij de resultaten van jouw assessment hebben ontvangen, zullen we de procedure vervolgen. Uiteraard ontvang jij als deelnemer van het assessment ook de resultaten.

Meer weten? Neem dan contact met ons op!

PGGM en hybride werken

Bij PGGM hebben we een hybride werkomgeving gecreëerd die ons in staat stelt om flexibiliteit en samenwerking te combineren. Onze medewerkers hebben de mogelijkheid om zowel op kantoor als op afstand te werken, afhankelijk van hun persoonlijke voorkeuren en de aard van hun werk. Door hybride werken aan te bieden, willen we onze medewerkers de vrijheid geven om hun eigen werkstijl te ontwikkelen, maar tegelijkertijd de voordelen van een gezamenlijke werkplek behouden.

Behandeling sollicitatie

Na ontvangst van jouw sollicitatie gaan wij via een aantal stappen kijken of jij bij ons past en wij bij jou. Bij de procedure voor de werving en selectie van nieuwe medewerkers verzamelt en verwerkt PGGM persoonsgegevens, hierbij kan ook naar sociale media gekeken worden. PGGM vindt het belangrijk dat dit zorgvuldig, vertrouwelijk, transparant en met in achtneming van de algemene verordening gegevensbescherming en aanverwante wet-en regelgeving plaatsvindt. Lees in dit document wat er gebeurt met je persoonsgegevens.

Aan intermediairs

We weten dat er veel partijen zijn die graag met ons mee willen zoeken of hun diensten willen aanbieden voor deze vacature, maar bij PGGM werven we nieuwe collega’s zelf. Acquisitie naar een werving & selectie-opdracht of onaangekondigde aanbiedingen van CV's stellen we dan ook niet op prijs en nemen wij niet in behandeling. Mochten we er niet uitkomen, dan bellen we jou.

Wij communiceren te allen tijde via officiële PGGM e-mail adressen (@pggm.nl). Bent u benaderd door een derde partij en/of twijfelt u of contact daadwerkelijk in opdracht is van PGGM? Check dan gerust of er daadwerkelijk een legitieme samenwerking is met derde partijen door ons te mailen of bellen.

new_jobs.description:
Over de functie

ml. T236635

Je gaat aan de slag als Senior Full Stack Developer binnen een team dat werkt aan de innovatie en doorontwikkeling van diensten voor de divisie Toezicht. Je ontwikkelt oplossingen die bijdragen aan wettelijke taken en het efficiënter en robuuster maken van processen. Je werkt in een Scrum-team aan een technisch landschap met onder meer Angular, Azure Functions, .NET, Azure API-Management, Azure Service Bus, Dynamics 365, SharePoint en Azure. In deze rol realiseer je user stories, los je incidenten op en draag je actief bij aan de verdere professionalisering van de engineeringpraktijk.

Wat ga je doen

Je ontwikkelt en beheert schaalbare applicaties en integraties op basis van Microsoft Azure, .NET, python en moderne cloud-native architectuurprincipes.
Je ontwikkelt integraties tussen DNB-systemen en externe platformen, waarbij je gebruikmaakt van onder andere Azure Functions, Logic Apps, API Management, Service Bus en event-driven architectuur.
Je realiseert koppelingen met onder meer Dynamics 365, Power Platform, SharePoint, Mijn DNB, Azure-platformdiensten en andere bedrijfskritische systemen.
Je ontwerpt, ontwikkelt en onderhoudt CI/CD-pipelines in Azure DevOps met behulp van YAML, Bicep en Infrastructure as Code-principes.
Je schrijft kwalitatief hoogwaardige software volgens principes als Clean Architecture, Domain Driven Design, SOLID en gelaagde architecturen.
Je waarborgt softwarekwaliteit door middel van unit testing, integratietesten, e2e testen, code reviews, security-scans en geautomatiseerde kwaliteitscontroles.
Je werkt met moderne databronnen en kiest de juiste opslagtechnologie voor het vraagstuk, zoals Azure Cosmos DB, SQL-databases en event stores.
Je hebt kennis van containerisatie en cloud-native deploymentmodellen, bijvoorbeeld Docker en Kubernetes.
Je ondersteunt het team bij het analyseren en oplossen van incidenten, performance-vraagstukken en complexe verstoringen binnen de applicatieketen.
Je stemt werkzaamheden af met andere DevOps-teams, architecten en leveranciers en zorgt voor consistente integratiepatronen binnen het landschap.
Je hebt kennis van API-ontwerp, API-beheer en integratiepatronen, specifiek in relatie tot SharePoint, Dynamics 365 en andere Microsoft-platformen.
Je maakt gebruik van moderne ontwikkelmethodieken zoals DevOps, GitOps, CI/CD en Spec-Driven Development.
Je onderzoekt en benut de mogelijkheden van Generative AI en AI-assisted softwareontwikkeling om de kwaliteit en snelheid van softwareontwikkeling verder te vergroten.
Je draagt bij aan het continu verbeteren van ontwikkelstandaarden, softwaredesignrichtlijnen en engineering practices binnen de organisatie.
Je gebruikt hulpmiddelen zoals Renovate of vergelijkbare dependency-managementoplossingen om softwarecomponenten actueel en veilig te houden.

Over jou
