The role involves close collaboration with business stakeholders, product owners, developers, and operations teams to ensure successful software delivery. The successful candidate will support both manual and automated testing activities, with hands-on TOSCA experience being highly desirable. Translate business requirements and functional specifications into test scenarios and system configurations.
Design, execute, and maintain functional, integration, and regression test cases (manual and automated).

Experience within Banking, Cards, Payments, or Financial Services environments is highly desirable.

Excellent communication and relationship-building skills, with the ability to engage effectively with diverse stakeholders.

Hos Hogia Redovisning & Revision får du en nyckelroll där du kombinerar ledarskap, teknikstrategi och innovation med ett nära samarbete med verksamheten.

Om rollen

Som Engineering Manager har du det övergripande ansvaret för ett utvecklingsteam med ca 10 medarbetare bestående av utvecklare och testare. Ditt främsta fokus är att skapa förutsättningar för teamets framgång genom ett närvarande och utvecklande ledarskap, samtidigt som du leder den tekniska utvecklingen framåt.

Du ansvarar för att driva de strategiskt viktiga teknikfrågorna inom området och säkerställa en hållbar utveckling av våra produkter. Rollen innebär ett stort fokus på modernisering, automation och AI-drivna arbetssätt där du tillsammans med teamet identifierar möjligheter att effektivisera utveckling, kvalitetssäkring och leverans. Du följer aktivt utvecklingen inom teknikområdet, omvärldsbevakar och omsätter relevanta trender till konkreta initiativ som stärker både produkterna och arbetssätten.

En viktig del av uppdraget är att balansera förvaltningen av våra hybrida Core-produkter med den fortsatta utvecklingen av våra molnbaserade lösningar. Du arbetar nära produktledning, kravställare och andra utvecklingsteam för att säkerställa rätt tekniska vägval över tid.

Rollen är huvudsakligen strategisk och ledarskapsorienterad, men beroende på situation och behov kan du även bidra operativt i tekniska frågor eller utvecklingsarbete.

Är du den vi söker?

Vi tror att du har en eftergymnasial utbildning inom systemutveckling eller motsvarande samt flera års erfarenhet av modern systemutveckling. Du har tidigare haft personalansvar eller lett utvecklingsteam och känner dig trygg i att kombinera ett coachande ledarskap med tekniskt beslutsfattande.

Du har erfarenhet av moderna utvecklingsmiljöer och molnbaserade lösningar samt ett intresse för hur automation och AI kan skapa effektivare utvecklingsprocesser och bättre produkter.

Vi arbetar bland annat med: C#, .NET Core, Microservices, Azure DevOps, Git, React, HTML/CSS, SQL, Cosmos DB, C++, MFC, XML

Du behöver inte ha erfarenhet av samtliga tekniker, men du har en bred teknisk förståelse och en vilja att fortsätta utvecklas tillsammans med teamet.

Som person är du en trygg och prestigelös ledare som bygger engagemang, tydlighet och samarbete. Du är strukturerad och har förmågan att prioritera, skapa riktning och driva förändring även när flera initiativ pågår samtidigt. Du trivs med att arbeta långsiktigt, har ett genuint intresse för ny teknik och inspireras av att omsätta nya möjligheter till affärsnytta. Du kommunicerar obehindrat på både svenska och engelska och samarbetar naturligt med kollegor, chefer och externa samarbetspartners.

Vi kommer att lägga stor vikt vid dina personliga egenskaper.

Vad vi erbjuder

Hos oss bygger du lösningar som används av tusentals kunder och blir en viktig del av vår resa mot framtidens molnbaserade affärssystem. Du får möjlighet att påverka både teknikval, arbetssätt och teamets utveckling i en organisation som värdesätter innovation, kvalitet och långsiktighet.

Vi erbjuder goda utvecklingsmöjligheter, en hälsosam balans mellan arbete och fritid samt attraktiva förmåner. Vi satsar på hälsa och erbjuder flera träningsaktiviteter, möjlighet att arbeta hemifrån ett par dagar i veckan och en arbetsmiljö där kompetensutveckling uppmuntras.

Hos Hogia får du en roll där ditt ledarskap och din tekniska förståelse blir avgörande för att forma framtidens produkter.

Tjänsten är placerad i Stenungsund med möjlighet till att arbeta två dagar i veckan på distans.

Vi arbetar med löpande urval och intervjuer, vilket innebär att tjänsten kan tillsättas innan sista ansökningsdag.

Välkommen med din ansökan!

Om Hogia-gruppen

Hogia utvecklar, säljer och supportar programvaror och IT-system för företag som effektivt vill fokusera på sina verksamheter i stället för krånglig och tidsödande administration. Vi erbjuder allt från mindre löne- och bokföringsprogram för småföretagaren till kompletta, branschspecifika IT-lösningar och -system för exempelvis kollektivtrafik, åkerier, godsterminaler, revisionsbyråer och fastighetsbolag. I Hogiagruppen finns 30 operativa bolag, som vart och ett verkar inom ett väl definierat verksamhetsområde. Vår organisationsform bygger uttalat på småskalighet och entreprenörsanda. Företagskulturen skapar engagerade medarbetare. Tillsammans ger vi våra kunder de bästa tänkbara affärslösningarna. Hogia startade sin verksamhet 1980 i Stenungsund. I dag har den privatägda koncernen totalt 650 anställda på kontor i Sverige, Norge och Finland. Mer information om Hogia finns på www.hogia.se.

Vi på Hogia utvecklar och levererar branschspecifika, verksamhetsstödjande system. Vi har mängder av affärskritiska branschanpassade system som underlättar livet, för att inte tala om lösningar inom ekonomi, lön/HR som passar alla, oavsett bransch.

Vi är experter på att göra administrativa och operativa processer enklare, effektivare och faktiskt lite roligare.

Välkommen till en hel värld av smarta branschlösningar!

new_jobs.title: Principal Data Architect
new_jobs.description:
emagine is looking for: Principal Data Architect – Group Information Model and Data Architecture

emagine is looking for a Principal Data Architect for our client in the financial and information services sector. The client operates across four Nordic markets and is at the start of a multi-year transformation. Data from Oracle, Db2 and mainframe environments will be consolidated into a governed operational data platform on AWS, while existing systems continue to support the business.

This is the most senior architectural role in the programme. You will own the Group information model, domain model and data architecture. The core challenge is to distinguish genuine business differences between markets from historical inconsistencies, and to build a common model that endures regardless of technology choices. The programme is deliberately small: existing staff supported by a handful of senior specialists.

Responsibilities

Define the Group information model: common business concepts, entities and relationships, and where local variation is required.
Own the domain model, including bounded contexts, context maps, shared language and service boundaries based on DDD. The model is implemented through versioned data contracts, semantic models and domain services.
Introduce anti-corruption layers between new domain contracts and legacy systems of record.
Define how the model, governance and data contracts are implemented on the operational data platform, and contribute to platform decisions.
Design the migration architecture, covering patterns, reconciliation, dependency sequencing and acceptance criteria for a gradual transition without a big-bang cutover.
Design data governance: classification, lineage, information ownership, retention, access control and country-specific regulatory requirements.
Set architecture principles, standards and review processes, and support delivery teams.

Requirements

Principal-level experience in data architecture, information architecture or enterprise architecture within a regulated business.
Experience establishing common information models across multiple markets, business lines or organisations.
Practical experience with domain-driven design (bounded contexts, context maps, domain ownership).
Experience designing and governing large-scale analytical or operational data platforms, such as Databricks, Snowflake, Microsoft Fabric or equivalent.
Experience with data migration or CDC from operational systems such as Oracle, Db2 or PostgreSQL.
Experience treating schemas, data contracts and semantic models as versioned engineering artefacts.
Solid understanding of GDPR, DORA and related governance requirements.
Strong ability to build consensus across business and technology teams.
Fluent written and spoken English.

Nice to have

Experience from Nordic financial services, information services or other regulated data businesses.
Domain knowledge in credit, risk, lending or decisioning.
Modernisation of mainframe, Db2 or Oracle environments.
ML/AI governance, feature stores or model lineage.
Evaluation of public-cloud, sovereign-cloud or hybrid deployment models.
Swedish

Technology landscape

AWS, Amazon S3, CDC from Oracle/Db2/PostgreSQL, SQL, Python, Java/Spring Boot, rules-engine based decisioning, and tooling for metadata, lineage and information governance.

Location

Stockholm, hybrid with remote work as required.

Start:
October/November

The consultant will provide architectural leadership across multiple initiatives and delivery streams, collaborating closely with business stakeholders, architects, engineering teams, and external vendors. The role is critical in balancing platform stability and resilience while enabling transformation, modernization, and simplification of core banking capabilities.

Start: 2026-11-02

End: 2027-01-31 (will most likely be extended)

About The Role

Core Banking Architecture Leadership

Define and drive the architecture roadmap for Temenos T24 and related Core Banking capabilities.
Develop target-state architecture, architectural principles, and standards aligned with business and technology strategies.
Provide end-to-end solution and architecture leadership across complex programs and initiatives.
Ensure consistency, scalability, maintainability, and sustainability across the Core Banking ecosystem.

Solution Design and Integration

Translate business requirements into practical and robust architecture solutions.
Design integrations between Core Banking, payments, lending, deposits, digital channels, customer management platforms, and enterprise data services.
Identify and manage application interfaces, data flows, dependencies, and integration patterns.
Evaluate architectural alternatives and provide recommendations based on business value, risk, and technical complexity.

Platform Modernization

Promote API-first, event-driven, and cloud-enabled architecture approaches where appropriate.
Simplify technology landscapes and improve maintainability, operability, and testability.
Identify opportunities for automation, standardization, and reuse across teams and business domains.

Governance, Resilience and Risk Management

Lead architecture reviews and ensure alignment with enterprise architecture standards and regulatory requirements.
Identify architecture risks, technical debt, and lifecycle challenges, and propose remediation plans.
Ensure an architectural runway that supports both current deliveries and future transformation initiatives.

Stakeholder Management

Collaborate with business leaders, product organizations, engineering teams, enterprise architects, and external partners.
Act as a trusted advisor for strategic Core Banking initiatives and technology investment decisions.
Communicate complex architectural concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Mentor architects and senior engineers while promoting sound architectural decision-making.

Deep understanding of Core Banking platforms, processes, and integration landscapes.

Experience working across multiple teams, products, domains, or markets in complex enterprise environments.
Strong background in banking environments with demanding requirements around security, resilience, availability, and regulatory compliance.

Preferred Skills

Experience with API-led and event-driven architecture patterns.
Knowledge of cloud-native and hybrid architecture environments.
Strong stakeholder management and communication skills.
Experience with enterprise architecture governance and technology roadmaps.
Understanding of payments, lending, deposits, customer information management, and data platforms.

Consultant Profile

We are looking for a senior architect who combines deep Core Banking expertise with strong strategic and communication capabilities. The ideal consultant is comfortable operating at both executive and technical levels, influencing decisions, driving modernization efforts, and ensuring long-term architectural sustainability in a highly regulated banking environment.

Join us, be part of more.

We’re so much more than an energy company. We’re a family of brands revolutionising how we power the planet. We're energisers. We make it, store it, move it, sell it and mend it.

About your team:

At Centrica Energy, our mission is to move it.

We’re energy movers by nature. We’re a global renewable energy trading company which helps move energy from source to use – powering businesses, homes, and societies as they transition to a new sustainable energy future. If the idea of working to create a sustainable energy future also moves you, we may very well be the right place for you.

Technology is central to how we move energy from source to use. As a Software Engineer, you will help build and evolve the platforms that support our renewable trading business while contributing to a major effort to bring multiple systems together into a single, long-term technology foundation. Working alongside skilled engineers and business experts, you will have the opportunity to influence both the solutions we build and the direction we take next.

About The Role

We are bringing together several platforms that have supported different parts of our business over many years. As we create a more unified technology landscape, we are investing in the teams that will build, evolve, and maintain these systems for the future. This creates an exciting opportunity for experienced developers to influence both the direction of our technology and the way we work together as engineering teams.

Depending on your skills, experience, and interests, you will either join an existing team where you can quickly contribute and learn from colleagues with deep domain expertise or become part of a team focused on shaping the next generation of our platforms. We carefully match new colleagues to the environment where they are most likely to succeed, supported by a structured onboarding programme, a dedicated buddy, and experienced colleagues who will help you build domain knowledge from day one.

As part of this role, you will:

Lead the design, development, and enhancement of backend services and APIs using .NET C#.
Drive architectural decisions that ensure our solutions are scalable, secure, and maintainable.
Build and enhance desktop applications using WPF while integrating systems through modern Web APIs.
Develop resilient cloud-native solutions using AWS, Kubernetes, messaging technologies, and modern database platforms.
Mentor fellow engineers and contribute to engineering excellence through code reviews, testing practices, and continuous improvement.

About You

You are an experienced software engineer who enjoys solving complex problems and turning ideas into reliable, scalable solutions. You thrive in collaborative environments where people challenge each other, share knowledge, and work together towards a common goal. While strong technical skills are important, we're equally interested in your curiosity, judgement, and ability to help others succeed.

We're particularly interested in candidates who bring:

Significant experience developing enterprise applications using .NET C#.
Strong knowledge of modern software engineering practices, including cloud technologies, system design, and DevOps.
Proven experience designing distributed systems and making sound architectural decisions.
A passion for building maintainable, well-tested software with long-term sustainability in mind.
The ability to partner effectively with business stakeholders, alongside experience with technologies such as AWS, Kubernetes, Kafka, RabbitMQ, Datadog, MongoDB, PostgreSQL, and MSSQL.

Previous experience within energy trading is beneficial but not essential. Strong engineering capability, technical leadership, and a growth mindset matter far more than industry background.

About Centrica Energy

We are a leading energy trading and optimisation business, helping move energy from source to use across global markets. We trade power, gas, LNG, and environmental products, connecting producers, suppliers, and customers while helping make energy systems more flexible, resilient, and sustainable. We are Energy Movers by Nature, driven by our purpose of energising a greener, fairer future.

From eight offices across Europe, Asia, and North America, our teams combine market expertise, data, technology, and trading capabilities to help balance supply and demand, manage risk, and support the transition towards a more sustainable energy future. We are also one of Europe's largest renewable asset managers, with substantial renewable and flexible generation capacity under management.

Joining us means becoming part of an ambitious, international organisation where technology is central to everything we do. Together, we are building solutions that help power businesses, homes, and societies while creating the energy systems of tomorrow.

Why should you apply?

We’re not a perfect place – but we’re a people place. Our priority is supporting all of the different realities our people face. Life is about so much more than work. We get it. That’s why we’ve designed our total rewards to give you the flexibility to choose what you need, when you need it, making sure that you and your family are supported not only financially, but physically and emotionally too. Visit the link below to discover why we’re a great place to work and what being part of more means for you.

If you're full of energy, fired up about sustainability, and ready to craft not only a better tomorrow, but a better you, then come and find your purpose in a team where your voice matters, your growth is non-negotiable, and your ambitions are our priority.
